_note: Illustrative flood-prone zones for Caloocan City, based on generally known flood-prone barangays/roads (areas near the Tullahan-Tinajeros river system and low-lying north Caloocan). Polygon shapes are simplified approximations for prototyping only. Replace with official DOST Project NOAH / DOST-ASTI hazard maps (noah.up.edu.ph, GeoRiskPH) for real-world or thesis-final accuracy.

zones.name: Dagat-Dagatan Lowland Area
zones.description: Low-lying reclaimed area with a history of localized flooding during monsoon rains.

zones.name: Bagumbong Riverside Zone
zones.description: Residential area near tributary creeks, prone to flash flooding during heavy/prolonged rainfall.

zones.name: Camarin Flood-Prone Corridor
zones.description: Historically flood-affected corridor along Camarin Road, near the Tullahan River basin.

zones.name: Zabarte Road / Deparo Critical Zone
zones.description: One of the most frequently reported flood hotspots in Caloocan, adjacent to the Tullahan River; prone to severe flooding during typhoons.

zones.name: Tala Lowland Pockets
zones.description: Scattered low-elevation pockets near the Novaliches boundary with moderate flood incidence.
